event_definition.description: saleable Binance Spot coin rises at least 25% from the scanner-selected local-low baseline within 480 minutes
event_definition.baseline: latest occurrence of the lowest one-minute low in the preceding 479 completed minutes
event_definition.saleability: at least 500 quote units of seller-initiated executed notional within 300 seconds after the exact threshold-crossing trade

evidence_populations.events: all saleable 25% events, at most the earliest qualifying event per symbol per UTC day
evidence_populations.daily_universe_coverage: all canonical symbols from the source scan snapshot

negative_selection.baseline_algorithm: same 480-minute rolling local-low selection used for events
